ChangelogPage.title: Changelog
ChangelogPage.description: See the latest features, improvements, and fixes on Headhunt.cc.

cloudBackup.title: Google Drive Backup
cloudBackup.description: Automatic backups, cross-device synchronization, version history, restore, and a persistent Google session.

localBackup.title: Local Backup
localBackup.description: Download and restore all data through JSON, with validation and data comparison before restoring.

profiles.title: Profile Management
profiles.description: Add, rename, select, and delete profiles with a safer and clearer confirmation flow.

importV2.title: Tracker Import V2
importV2.description: More reliable imports with legacy data migration, destination profile selection, and profile-safe synchronization.

statistics.title: Clearer Statistics
statistics.description: Statistics now share one calculation source and every value includes an explanation, including AVG Pity, Guaranteed, and free pull rules.

interface.title: Interface Refresh
interface.description: Settings and Import menus, modals, tabs, tooltips, buttons, and empty states are now more consistent and comfortable to use.

HomePage.title: Arknights: Endfield Pity Tracker (For Real)
HomePage.description: A free tool to track your gacha pity in Arknights: Endfield. Easily check pull history and pity count.
HomePage.countdown: {days, plural, =0 {} other {{days}d }}{hours, plural, =0 {} other {{hours}h }}{minutes, plural, =0 {} other {{minutes}m }}{seconds, plural, =0 {} other {{seconds}s}}

OperatorsPage.title: Operators - Arknights: Endfield
OperatorsPage.description: Browse Arknights: Endfield operators by rarity, element, and class to help you build your team.

WeaponsPage.title: Weapons - Arknights: Endfield
WeaponsPage.description: Browse Arknights: Endfield weapons by rarity and weapon type, with detailed stats and skill information.

TrackerPage.title: Headhunt Tracker - Arknights: Endfield
TrackerPage.description: Track your Arknights: Endfield pity and gacha history with Headhunt.cc.

migrationNotice.title: Thank you for continuing to use Headhunt Tracker
migrationNotice.fixedLabel: Pity calculation improvements are now active
migrationNotice.description: We have fixed an issue that caused some pity calculations to be inaccurate. We will continue improving this tool. If you find another bug, please report it through Discord.

TrackerPage.importInstruction: Import your history once. After that, use the <bold>Sync</bold> button whenever you want to update the data. All data is stored locally in your browser. Up to 90 days of gacha history will be imported.
TrackerPage.guaranteedDesc: Rate-Up Guaranteed within the first {limit} pulls on each banner

DetailRecords.totalPullsDescription: The number of all recorded results, including free pulls.
DetailRecords.totalArsenalTicketDescription: The estimated value of all issues at 198 Arsenal Tickets each. This is not the amount actually spent.
DetailRecords.totalOroberylDescription: The estimated value of all headhunts at 500 Oroberyl each. This is not the amount actually spent.
DetailRecords.rarityCountDescription: The number of all {rarity}★ results, including results from free pulls.
DetailRecords.r6AvgPityDescription: The average pity when obtaining a 6★. Guaranteed results are included, while a 6★ from a free pull is counted with 0 pity.
DetailRecords.rotateWinRateDescription: The percentage of Rotate or Rate-Up wins among all non-Guaranteed 6★ results.
DetailRecords.rateupWinRateDescription: The percentage of direct Rate-Up wins among all non-Guaranteed 6★ results. Guaranteed results are not counted as Rate-Up wins.

SettingsMenu.title: Settings
SettingsMenu.addProfileDescription: Create a new profile for another Arknights: Endfield account.
SettingsMenu.editProfileDescription: Enter a new name for the “{name}” profile.
SettingsMenu.deleteProfileConfirmation: The “{name}” profile and all of its data will be permanently deleted.
SettingsMenu.cannotDeleteOnlyProfile: The only profile cannot be deleted.
SettingsMenu.description: Here is the total amount of data you currently have.
SettingsMenu.securityWarning: Keep this file private. It may contain an import URL or token that grants access to your gacha history.
SettingsMenu.backupDescription: Download all of your data and profiles.
SettingsMenu.restoreDescription: Restore your data using a previous backup file.
SettingsMenu.restoreConfirmation: Compare the current browser data with the selected backup, then choose which data you want to use.
SettingsMenu.identical: The JSON file already matches the browser data. No changes were applied.
SettingsMenu.invalid: This backup file is invalid or unsupported.
SettingsMenu.googleDriveDescription: Save or restore your data with Google Drive.
SettingsMenu.googleNotConfigured: Google Drive backup has not been configured by the site administrator.
SettingsMenu.unlinkGoogleDriveDescription: All backup history in Google Drive will be permanently deleted, then Headhunt.cc access to this Google account will be revoked. This action cannot be undone.
SettingsMenu.autoBackupDescription: Data changes are backed up automatically while Google is connected.
SettingsMenu.chooseInitialDataDescription: A backup was found in Google Drive. Keep the current browser data or restore the latest Google Drive backup.
SettingsMenu.driveBackedUp: Google Drive backup is up to date.
SettingsMenu.driveOutdated: Local changes have not been backed up to Google Drive yet.
SettingsMenu.driveNotFound: No backup was found in this Google Drive account.
SettingsMenu.driveError: Google Drive could not be reached. Connect again and retry.
SettingsMenu.reconnectRequired: Your Google session expired. Reconnect to continue.
SettingsMenu.dataHistoryDescription: Choose which backup version you want to restore.

ImportRecords.title: Import Gacha History
ImportRecords.urlDescription: Paste the URL generated by the PowerShell script.
ImportRecords.targetProfileDescription: Choose the profile that will receive the imported data.
ImportRecords.singleTargetProfileDescription: Imported data will be saved to the following profile.
ImportRecords.invalidUrl: That URL is not valid yet. Make sure you paste the complete URL generated by the script.
ImportRecords.clipboardError: The clipboard could not be accessed. Please paste the URL manually.
ImportRecords.comingSoonDescription: A practical and secure import guide for this platform is currently being prepared.

WindowsSteps.openHeadHuntingDesc: Launch <game>Arknights: Endfield</game>, then open <menu>Headhunting Details</menu> so its history URL can be detected.
WindowsSteps.openPowerShellDesc: Press the <key>Windows</key> key, search for “PowerShell”, then launch <app>Windows PowerShell</app>.
WindowsSteps.runCommandDesc: Copy the command below into <app>Windows PowerShell</app>, then press <key>Enter</key>. Once the URL appears, it will be copied to your clipboard automatically. Paste it into the import field below.

ImportStatus.urlExpired: URL expired, please re-import using a new URL
ImportStatus.unknownError: Unknown Error, please try again later
